contexts.description: Provides functionalities for browsing, searching, and viewing detailed information about products available on the platform. It focuses on product discovery for all users.
contexts.ownership_rationale: This context is responsible for the public-facing view of products, enabling users to find and evaluate items. It centralizes product data for display and search optimization.

contexts.description: Manages the lifecycle of user accounts, including registration, login, authentication, and profile management. It ensures secure access and maintains user-specific information.
contexts.ownership_rationale: This context encapsulates all core functionalities related to user identity, security, and personal data. It is a foundational service that other contexts depend on for user validation.

contexts.description: Enables registered users to add new products for sale, manage their existing listings, and view a dashboard summarizing their sales activities (products added, offers received, requests made).
contexts.ownership_rationale: This context handles the 'seller' side of the marketplace, focusing on the creation and management of product offerings. It enforces rules like 'only registered users can add products.'

contexts.description: Provides users with access to the website's user manual and a mechanism to contact developers for assistance or feedback.
contexts.ownership_rationale: This context groups all non-core e-commerce support functionalities, ensuring users have resources for self-help and direct communication with support personnel.

contexts.description: Manages the process of users making and receiving offers and requests for products, storing and tracking these interactions.
contexts.ownership_rationale: This context is dedicated to the negotiation and transaction initiation aspects between buyers and sellers, distinct from product listing or general product information.
